question: Which scientist synthesised an organic compound, urea, from an inorganic compound, ammonium cyanate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**F Wohler**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Friedrich Wöhler**, a **German chemist**.
 
• Conducted **synthesis** in **1828**.
 
• Created **urea from ammonium cyanate**.
 
• Experiment challenged **vitalism theory**.
 
• Proved **organic compounds** can be **artificially produced**.
 
• **Catalyst** for **modern organic chemistry**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kolbe**

 
 
• Name: **Adolph Wilhelm Hermann Kolbe.**
 
• **German chemist**, born in **1818.**
 
• Known for his work in** organic chemistry.**
 
• Made significant contributions to the understanding of **chemical reactions and structures.**
 
• Proposed the concept of **"structural formulas".**
 
• Studied the synthesis of organic compounds, including **salicylic acid** and **acetic acid.**
 
• His research laid the **groundwork **for **modern organic chemistry**.
 
 
 
• **Berthelot**
 
 
• **Marcellin Berthelot** (1827–1907)
 
• **French chemist and politician**
 
• Made significant contributions to **organic chemistry, thermochemistry, and chemical kinetics.**
 
• Proposed the principle of **maximum work in chemical thermodynamics.**
 
• Known for his work on combustion, particularly the study of **thermochemical equations.**
 
• Advocated for **science education **and served as **France's Minister of Public Instruction and Fine Arts**
 
 
 
• **Berzelius**
 
 
• **Jöns Jacob Berzelius** (1779–1848).
 
• **Swedish chemist.**
 
• Known as one of the **founders of modern chemistry.**
 
• Developed the **modern system of chemical symbols **and **notation,** including the use of letters to represent **elements and subscripts** to denote the n**umber of atoms in a compound.**
 
• **Introduced** the concept of **chemical formulas.**
 
• Discovered several **chemical elements**, including **silicon, selenium, thorium, and cerium.**
 
• Made significant contributions to **stoichiometry, catalysis, and chemical bonding.**
